rows.reason: Theme documents stored for tenants may carry its twelve open-ended fields: the theme-document iso schema admits them and the personality lowering reads them, and nothing proves the stored data absent or migrated. No bundled preset authors the interface any more.
rows.scope: Exported interface; it types `FlatTheme.motion`. The Brand Studio editor no longer authors the six open-ended fields (entrance, entranceDuration, hoverLift, hoverScale, pulseSpeed and skeletonStyle) and its file export no longer reads entranceDuration (WO-RET-06 W-4); drafts that carry them still round-trip. The four governed fields (intensity, durationScale, ambient, character) stay. No database was inspected: whether stored tenant payloads carry the open-ended fields was not measured.

evidence.note: Measured: the theme-document schema admits the open-ended motion fields. Not measured: stored tenant documents.
Measured: the personality lowering reads the open-ended fields from the flat theme.
